package core

// PlantedRenamedNew is the new name of PlantedRenamedOld.
func PlantedRenamedNew() int { return 2 }

// PlantedSignature gained a parameter.
func PlantedSignature(a int, b string) int { return a + len(b) }

// PlantedReplacement replaces PlantedDeprecated.
func PlantedReplacement(a int) int { return a }

// PlantedDeprecated is kept for callers of the old name.
//
// Deprecated: use PlantedReplacement.
func PlantedDeprecated(a int) int { return PlantedReplacement(a) }

// PlantedAdded is added by the change.
func PlantedAdded() int { return 3 }

// PlantedType loses a method in the change.
type PlantedType struct{}

// Kept is kept.
func (PlantedType) Kept() int { return 1 }

// PlantedValue changed its value.
const PlantedValue = "1.1"

// PlantedRetyped gained a type.
const PlantedRetyped string = "x"

// PlantedConstToVar became a variable.
var PlantedConstToVar = "y"
